notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
description:
Activate Heirloom Epic by tapping it and four creatures you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heirloom Epic.
Repeat.
